nl: 请假申请管理：查询有员工姓名、请假类型（年假/病假/事假）；表格展示员工姓名、请假类型、开始日期、结束日期、病假证明；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「病假证明」只在请假类型为「病假」时才需要填写，其余类型隐藏。
nlEn: Leave request management: query by employee name and leave type (annual / sick / personal); the table shows employee name, leave type, start date, end date, and sick-leave certificate; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "sick-leave certificate" is only needed when the leave type is "sick"; it is hidden for the other types.
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=ne — 非病假时隐藏病假证明（vue2/schema）
